DonorPulse API Reference

Everything you need to help a non-profit fundraising director launch a capital campaign page with live donor progress bar.

GET/api/v1/resources

Returns a paginated list of resources. Supports filtering by status, date range, and category.

curl -X GET "https://api.donorpulse.com/v1/resources?status=active&limit=20" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer your_api_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
POST/api/v1/resources

Creates a new resource. Requires a valid name and at least one category tag.

curl -X POST "https://api.donorpulse.com/v1/resources" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer your_api_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "New Resource", "category": "analytics", "active": true}'
